en.answer: If <<8538>> would be destroyed by an opponent's effect, and <<6505>> is discarded to the Graveyard instead, since it's treated as beng discarded due to the effect of <<8538>>, the <<6505>> that was discarded to the Graveyard can be Special Summoned.
en.question: When <<8538>> would be destroyed by an opponent's effect, if <<6505>> is discarded to the Graveyard instead, can <<6505>> itself be Special Summoned?
en.title: Can a <<6505>> that was discarded when <<8538>> would be destroyed be Special Summoned?
